today.q: What are you about to decide?
today.hint: Say what you want to do, and why…
today.example1: Quit my job to do a one-year master's in finance
today.example2: Open a specialty coffee shop in Hangzhou
today.example3: Take a demo to Silicon Valley to raise money
today.example4: Buy my first home in Chengdu next year
past.q: Which moment do you want to go back to?
past.hint: A moment that really happened, and whose place you want to stand in…
past.example1: 2015, in the place of Theranos's founder
past.example2: Steve Jobs in 1985, pushed out of Apple
past.example3: The week before Lehman fell in 2008
past.example4: The year Nokia decided against Android
noneInProgress: No projects being researched or built.
